# Defensive Duelist

## Feats

*General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Dexterity 13+)*

You gain the following benefits.

***Ability Score Increase.*** Increase your [Dexterity score](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:The%20Six%20Abilities?expansion=32231) by 1, to a maximum of 20.

***Parry.*** If you’re holding a [Finesse](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Weapons?expansion=32231#Finesse) weapon and another creature hits you with a melee attack, you can take a [Reaction](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Reaction) to add your [Proficiency Bonus](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Proficiency?expansion=32231#Proficiency%20Bonus) to your [Armor Class](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Armor%20Class), potentially causing the attack to miss you. You gain this bonus to your [AC](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Armor%20Class) against melee attacks until the start of your next turn.

# Dual Wielder

## Feats

*General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Strength or Dexterity 13+)*

You gain the following benefits.

***Ability Score Increase.*** Increase your [Strength](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:The%20Six%20Abilities?expansion=32231) or [Dexterity score](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:The%20Six%20Abilities?expansion=32231) by 1, to a maximum of 20.

***Enhanced Dual Wielding.*** When you take the [Attack action](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Attack%20%5BAction%5D) on your turn and attack with a weapon that has the [Light](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Weapons?expansion=32231#Light) property, you can make one extra attack as a [Bonus Action](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Bonus%20Action) later on the same turn with a different weapon, which must be a Melee weapon that lacks the [Two-Handed](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Weapons?expansion=32231#Two-Handed) property. You don’t add your [ability modifier](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:The%20Six%20Abilities?expansion=32231#Ability%20Modifiers) to the extra attack’s damage unless that modifier is negative.

***Quick Draw.*** You can draw or stow two weapons that lack the [Two-Handed](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Weapons?expansion=32231#Two-Handed) property when you would normally be able to draw or stow only one.

# Elemental Adept

## Feats

*General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature)*

You gain the following benefits.

***Ability Score Increase.*** Increase your [Intelligence](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:The%20Six%20Abilities?expansion=32231), [Wisdom](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:The%20Six%20Abilities?expansion=32231), or [Charisma score](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:The%20Six%20Abilities?expansion=32231) by 1, to a maximum of 20.

***Energy Mastery.*** Choose one of the following [damage types](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Damage%20Types): Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. [Spells](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Spell) you cast ignore [Resistance](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Resistance) to damage of the chosen type. In addition, when you [roll damage](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Damage%20Roll) for a [spell](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Spell) you cast that deals damage of that type, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2.

***Repeatable.*** You can take this feat more than once, but you must choose a different [damage type](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Damage%20Types) each time for Energy Mastery.

# Fey-Touched

## Feats

![](https://files.d20.io/images/406407127/Kp5mrP7A1OWenKDmYW6EWw/original.png?1724433482)

*General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)*

Your exposure to the Feywild’s magic grants you the following benefits.

***Ability Score Increase.*** Increase your [Intelligence](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:The%20Six%20Abilities?expansion=32231), [Wisdom](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:The%20Six%20Abilities?expansion=32231), or [Charisma score](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:The%20Six%20Abilities?expansion=32231) by 1, to a maximum of 20.

***Fey Magic.*** Choose one level 1 [spell](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Spell) from the Divination or Enchantment school of magic. You always have that spell and the *[Misty Step](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Spells:Misty%20Step?expansion=32231)* spell prepared. You can cast each of these spells without expending a [spell slot](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Casting%20Spells?expansion=32231#Spell%20Slots). Once you cast either spell in this way, you can’t cast that spell in this way again until you finish a [Long Rest](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Long%20Rest). You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells’ spellcasting ability is the [ability](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:The%20Six%20Abilities?expansion=32231) increased by this feat.
